description:
Listing issues sweeps `.jit/issues/` once per process for retired read-lock sidecars. The sweep misses short-id sidecars, and a trait method exists only to keep it out of one caller.

## Background

- `list_issues` runs the sweep at `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:1304-1324`, guarded by `sidecars_swept` (`:395-397,442`), through the helper at `storage/lock.rs:440-492`. The helper requires `Uuid::parse_str(stem)` (`lock.rs:480-484`), so it skips short-id names. This repository holds 19 such files (`003f.lock`, `003f9f83.lock`, and others), untracked and ignored by `.gitignore:5`.
- The `read_issues` trait default (`storage/mod.rs:193-224`) and its JSON override (`json.rs:1326-1333`) have one production caller, document conformance (`commands/document.rs:215`). The trait doc on `list_issues` mentions it.
- Tests: `json.rs:2305,2411-2470`; `lock.rs:1015-1080`; `tests/cli_repo_workflow/artifact_conformance_cli_tests.rs:415-427,464-467`, which plants a sidecar to prove conformance leaves it in place.
- Docs: `docs/reference/storage-format.md:77-82`.

After the sweep is removed, `list_issues` still takes a shared lock on `.index.lock`, which it creates if absent (`lock.rs:255`). Lock files are gitignored runtime state.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The sidecar sweep, its once-per-process guard, its helper and the `read_issues` trait method with its override no longer exist, and document conformance lists issues through `list_issues`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Listing issues creates, rewrites or removes no file other than the storage's own index lock. One owning test compares the data root before and after a listing.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test plants or sweeps a read-lock sidecar.
- [hard] REQ-04: The storage-format reference does not describe the sweep.

## Notes

Stale sidecars already on disk are gitignored runtime residue, not repository content, and this change does not delete them.
title: Remove the read-lock sidecar sweep
